sources.title: MiniMax M1 launch announcement
sources.evidence: Dated June 16, 2025. Explicitly names both M1-40k and M1-80k, announces complete weights and API access, and distinguishes one-million-token context from 80,000-token reasoning output.

sources.title: MiniMax-M1-80k official model card
sources.evidence: Exact 80k repository card identifies its 80K thinking budget, one-million-token native context, hybrid-attention MoE, reasoning training, text generation and native function calling; links this checkpoint and its Apache-2.0 license.

sources.title: MiniMax-M1: Scaling Test-Time Compute Efficiently with Lightning Attention
sources.evidence: June 16, 2025 first-party report. Introduction explicitly states M1 comprises 456B total and 45.9B activated parameters with 32 experts; every seven Lightning Attention blocks are followed by a softmax-attention block. Table 1 names M1-80k with 1M input and 80K output. The 40K variant is an intermediate phase of 80K training.

sources.title: MiniMax-M1-80k checkpoint configuration
sources.evidence: MiniMaxM1ForCausalLM with 80 layers, hidden size 6144, 32 local experts/top 2, no shared expert intermediate width, and a 70/10 linear/full attention layer schedule. max_position_embeddings 10240000 is larger than documented native context and is not treated as a validated capability.

sources.title: MiniMax-M1-80k Apache License 2.0
sources.evidence: Full distributed Apache License Version 2.0 with copyright 2025 MiniMax, matching the exact model card metadata.

sources.title: MiniMax-M1 native function-call guide
sources.evidence: Developer guide explicitly starts an M1-80k server with the MiniMax tool-call parser and demonstrates tool schemas, structured arguments and tool results. Documented output includes think and tool_calls tags.

sources.title: MiniMax-M1-80k tokenizer and chat template
sources.evidence: Text-only GPT 2 tokenizer template serializes user/assistant text and structured tool calls. tokenizer model_max_length 40960000 is a configured ceiling, not proof of validated context quality.

sources.title: MiniMax-M1-80k reference implementation
sources.evidence: Static inspection confirms causal text-language modeling, Lightning Attention and full softmax attention, sparse top 2-of 32 expert routing, and untied embeddings/output weights. No vision/audio model path is present. No remote code was executed.

sources.title: Official M1-80k repository metadata and bounded weight access
sources.evidence: Public ungated repository at revision 8d1494b1a260e22040d5b9b2eb332eb44500b34d. The index maps 8,243 tensor keys to 414 shards. A pinned first-shard bytes=0-7 probe returned HTTP 206 with exactly 8 bytes. The automatic safetensors aggregate of 456,089,655,296 stored elements was not substituted for developer nominal parameter counts. June 13 repository creation alone does not establish a public release date.

sources.title: MiniMax M1 vLLM deployment guide
sources.evidence: Guide links both 40K/80K checkpoints and says particular 8-GPU setups can process 2M/5M context inputs. These hardware-serving capacity statements do not replace the exact model paper/card 1M supported-context specification.

sources.title: Current MiniMax model list
sources.evidence: Current available LLM table lists M 3/M 3.1 Flash. M1 is absent from both available and retired tables; surviving launch/card API links are not evidence of present native endpoint operation.

name.note: Readable name for the exact MiniMax-M1-80k checkpoint; the suffix identifies its thinking/output budget, not context length.

developer.note: Developer-owned announcement, model repository and copyright agree.

family.note: Retains the catalog broad MiniMax family key; specifically the M1 generation derived from Text-01.

release_date.note: Earliest explicit primary public announcement reviewed, corroborated by the same-day technical report. Corrects baseline June 17; June 13 repository creation is not independent proof of public availability.

open_weights.note: Exact 80k checkpoint is public and ungated; weight-file access was verified with a bounded HTTP 206 probe. No entire shard was downloaded.

license.note: Exact checkpoint contains the Apache-2.0 license; later MiniMax custom licenses are not transferred.

parameters_b.note: Developer nominal total in billions, explicitly assigned to M1 in the report introduction. No exact learned-tensor total is inferred from automatic Hugging Face storage metadata.

active_parameters_b.note: Developer nominal activated parameters per token. The exact embedding/component accounting convention is not separately specified; this is not total divided by expert count.

architecture.note: Hybrid-attention MoE: 80 decoder layers with 70 Lightning/linear-attention blocks and 10 full-softmax-attention blocks, top 2 of 32 experts per layer. MoE describes routing; hybrid attention is retained in the description and notes.

context_window.note: Preserves the documented native 1M context/input capacity. 80K is the separate reasoning/output budget. Larger config/tokenizer ceilings and 2M/5M hardware-serving statements do not establish a revised validated model limit.

modalities.note: Exact released checkpoint is text-to-text. Linked external MCP image/video/speech tools do not make these native model modalities.

reasoning.note: Exact 80K variant is trained for extended reasoning with CISPO reinforcement learning; the developer documents think-tag output and the separate 80K thinking budget.

tool_call.note: Exact 80k deployment example and native serialization support structured function calls and tool results.

description.value: Open-weight MoE reasoning model with hybrid Lightning and softmax attention, a one-million-token context and an 80K thinking budget.
description.note: Describes documented architecture and capacities without benchmark or cost superiority claims.

patch.description: Open-weight MoE reasoning model with hybrid Lightning and softmax attention, a one-million-token context and an 80K thinking budget.

sources.label: MiniMax-M1: Scaling Test-Time Compute Efficiently with Lightning Attention
Official M1-80k repository metadata and bounded weight access

patch.notes: 456B total and 45.9B active are developer nominal figures; the active-component counting convention is not separately specified. Hybrid attention uses seven Lightning blocks per softmax block, with top-2-of-32 MoE routing. The 1M context is distinct from the 80K thinking/output budget. Configuration/tokenizer ceilings of 10.24M/40.96M and hardware-serving claims of 2M/5M are not substituted for the documented native context. Public launch was June 16, 2025; June 13 repository creation is not proof of earlier public release. The exact 80k weights use Apache-2.0. Current native API availability is not established by surviving launch/card links.

summary: Verified all 14 fields. Adds nominal 456B total/45.9B active and MoE architecture; corrects launch date to June 16, 2025. Confirms Apache-2.0, text-only reasoning and native function calling. Separates one-million-token context from 80K thinking/output and larger unvalidated configuration ceilings. Exact public weights access verified using an 8-byte HTTP 206 probe; no full weights or remote code execution.
